I have made attempts to deal with creditors directly
they PREFER to continue contacting 3rd parties because they hope I'll just pay them to avoid the public humiliation.
I disagree with that entirely.
I'm not aware of any law that compels a 3rd party to provide current contact information for a debtor
they don't deserve to be harassed daily for months or years as punishment for not offering up that information.
no law that I know of says they have to if they aren't a party to the debt.
there is no clear and concise way I know of that a creditor can prove what was a reasonable belief.
You can't assume that certain relatives MUST know where a debtor is.

Consumers normally are unaware that their debt has been sold to a collection agency.
The collection agency wants the consumer to remit the payment to them
principal on the debt never decreases
The debt is there essentially, forever with added late charges, interest and other penalties.
I submit to the CFPB to finalize the "Know Before You Owe" rule
to outlay the debt validation rules so that consumers can make an informed choice before wasting their money on a debt they may not owe.
